method: Each 1440x2560 png viewed whole at 720 wide beside its sheet (nandini, nirala, tripathi, pushpa), the plate, and its scene anchor; then cropped at full resolution with ffmpeg: epaulette bars (s03, s15, s22, s16, s23), faces (s06, s09, s23), hands (s01, s11, s14, s18, s32, s36), wool pocket (s16), envelope tags (s30, s37), the s20 crop window taken from s14 (x 23-100%, y 0-77%), and the s32 overlay strip. Sides judged from pouch (her RIGHT hip) and pen (her LEFT pocket) for Nandini, medal/holster for Nirala, gamchha/cone for Tripathi, wool/bag for Pushpa.

s14.reason: The peanut hand breaks the shot's own placement rule, and s20 is cut from this frame. Prompt and shots.json say no part of the hand or peanut right of 20% across; measured at full resolution the peanut reaches about 24% and the thumb/fingers about 25-27% across, between 64% and 77% down. s20's window (23-100% across, 0-77% down, scale 1.3 which is the D-010 cap) therefore keeps a sliver of peanut and fingertips on its lower-left edge for 1.9 s; the crop cannot be widened past 1.3 to lose it. Second fault: the brass plate is drawn at about 30-45% down and 32-83% across, but ov_shield.surface says 24-36% down, so the overlay would sit partly on the wood above the plate.

s16.reason: Side error on the wool. Pushpa faces the camera, and the orange wool ball sits in her PICTURE-RIGHT cardigan pocket, i.e. her LEFT pocket. Her lock, the shot STATE ('right_pocket: orange wool ball') and the next Pushpa frame s23 (wool picture-left) all put it in her RIGHT pocket, so the ball jumps pockets across the cut within scene C. Cause: the s16 prompt says 'right pocket' only in body terms; s23's prompt adds 'on the picture-left' and came out right (D-013 rule 3).
